description: Match crystals to an intention using a short questionnaire (life focus, challenge, chakra, placement, style). Returns the top three crystals with their traditional chakra, element and how they are usually placed.

chakra.description: Which energetic center feels ready to be activated? Options: root (Root Chakra (Security, Stamina, Grounding)); solar (Solar Plexus (Courage, Willpower, Prosperity)); heart (Heart Chakra (Love, Empathy, Compassion)); throat_third (Throat & Third Eye (Truthful Voice & Intuition)); crown (Crown Chakra (Spiritual Connection & Cosmic Light))

challenge.description: What internal obstacle feels most prominent? Options: overthinking (Overactive mind & restless evenings); imposter (Self-doubt, creative stagnation & procrastination); drained (Absorbing negative vibes from environments or clients); heartache (Past emotional wounds, codependency or harsh self-criticism); scattered (Lack of focus, scattered ideas without concrete execution)

goal.description: What is your primary life focus right now? Options: wealth (Wealth, Career & Deal-Closing); love (Emotional Healing, Love & Relationships); peace (Mental Peace, Sleep & Stress Relief); protection (Energy Shielding & Grounding); wisdom (Clarity, Strategy & Authentic Expression)

preference.description: What energy format resonates most with your aesthetic? Options: tower (Standing Energy Obelisk / Generator Tower); raw (Raw Uncut Mineral Cluster / Geode Druzy); shield (Sleek Mirror Polish / Protective Bead Amulet)

space.description: Where will this crystal companion reside? Options: desk (Executive Desk / Financial Counter); bedroom (Nightstand / Rest & Healing Sanctuary); living (Main Living Room / Central Altar); carry (On my person / Daily Wear & Commute)

name: find_my_crystals
title: Crystal Match by Intention
